title: Sri Lanka Air Quality - DSD Level (2023-2026)
subtitle: Daily air pollutants and US AQI for all 339 Sri Lankan DSDs
description:
Daily air quality statistics (mean, minimum, maximum) for all 339 Divisional Secretariat Divisions of Sri Lanka, from 2023-01-01 to yesterday, updated every day.

Variables: PM2.5, PM10, nitrogen dioxide, sulphur dioxide, ozone, carbon monoxide, aerosol optical depth, dust, UV index and US AQI.

Source: Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service (CAMS) model data via the Open-Meteo Air Quality API. Values are model estimates on a ~45 km grid, not station readings. Boundaries: UN OCHA / Survey Department of Sri Lanka.

Code and full documentation: https://github.com/th33k/dataset-sri-lanka-air-quality

userSpecifiedSources: Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service (CAMS) global atmospheric composition model (ECMWF), via the Open-Meteo Air Quality API (https://open-meteo.com/en/docs/air-quality-api). DSD boundaries and P-codes: UN OCHA / Survey Department of Sri Lanka.
collectionMethodology: Hourly CAMS values are fetched from Open-Meteo at each DSD polygon centroid and aggregated to daily mean, minimum and maximum over the Sri Lanka calendar day (UTC+05:30). Only completed days (up to yesterday) are kept, and the last 3 days are re-fetched to pick up revisions. A GitHub Actions job runs this every day at 08:30 Sri Lanka time. Full method: https://github.com/th33k/dataset-sri-lanka-air-quality/blob/main/docs/METHODOLOGY.md
